name: Conjunctive and disjunctive wording
definition: And ordinarily joins cumulative items. Or ordinarily identifies alternatives.

name: Ejusdem generis

definition: Read a general tail of a list to cover items of the same kind as the specific examples that precede it.
use: Find a sensible shared class in the examples, then ask whether the disputed item belongs. Epic disputed whether employee litigation fell into the class illustrated by union and bargaining activities.
limits: The list may exemplify an intentionally broad field, and a class with the wrong level of generality can distort the text.
